method: Use each upstream factor's previous target index only to bound the next exact nearest-neighbor search. Expand the hint distance one representable step to retain original tie choice. No extra per-point state, point reduction, threshold, iteration or thread-budget changes.

variants.hint: Initial hint index stored in CorrespondenceSearch; rejected in favor of a call-scoped view, following inconclusive unpinned multithread timing.
variants.stateless: Call-scoped hint view; unhinted callers pass a constant invalid index, with no hint state stored in the shared search object.

verification.boundary_checks: Distance-gate equality, duplicate/equidistant targets, floating-point split planes, invalid hint indices and unbounded/nonfinite fallback; all three upstream optimizers retain exact single-thread results.

final_e2e.scope: Whole synthetic episode process, including test map construction, preparation/load, background threads and mixed localization states; not fixed 10 Hz deployment.

map_alignment.query_kind: Self-map crop, not an independent LiDAR scan; see framework_survey_20261017/make_inputs.py.
map_alignment.scope: Prepared-cloud alignment only; excludes map and source preprocessing. Product parameters except thread count. No localization acceptance/temporal pipeline in this probe.

pinned_batches.affinity: One performance core for one thread; four different physical performance cores for four threads; test subprocesses only.

probe_provenance.difference: Formatting only; early unpinned runs measured one alignment per initial pose, before adding warmup/batching.

limits: No RK3588, real 100 x 100 m MID360 replay, accuracy/false-lock or half-core acceptance measured.
Pinned batch measurements control CPU class and reduce millisecond-sample noise; unpinned exploratory samples are retained and cannot establish causation.
No universal tail-latency or RAM reduction claim; process RSS is reported, no extra point-state/cache allocated.
Build a clean published commit with actual Product identity before hardware acceptance.
